What kind of identifier a report's asset_id is: mmsi, icao24, callsign, or a provider's own id (hormuz.now, adsb.lol).

Maritime Mobile Service Identity: the nine-digit number of a vessel's radio, sent in every AIS message. Reissued when a ship is reflagged or sold, and sometimes shared or spoofed, so it identifies a radio at a time, not a hull (the IMO number does).

Speed over ground, in metres per second or knots.
